items_flat.title_en: OpenAI previews Private Safety Processing while reaffirming Zero Data Retention for frontier models
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 預覽 Private Safety Processing，重申前沿模型 Zero Data Retention
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced it will continue offering Zero Data Retention for eligible API customers and is previewing Private Safety Processing. The system is designed to detect misuse patterns across related interactions without giving OpenAI personnel access to the underlying prompts or responses. Broader rollout and a technical white paper are planned for September.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 宣布將持續為符合資格的 API 客戶提供 Zero Data Retention，並預覽 Private Safety Processing。該系統旨在跨相關互動偵測濫用模式，且不讓 OpenAI 人員存取底層提示或回應。預計 9 月更廣泛推出並發布技術白皮書。
items_flat.analysis_en: This directly addresses enterprise demand for stronger privacy as models handle longer autonomous work. It positions OpenAI differently from rivals requiring longer retention, though the exact technical guarantees remain to be detailed in the upcoming white paper.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此舉直接回應企業對更強隱私的需求，因模型開始處理更長自主工作。它與要求較長保留期的對手形成差異，但確切技術保證仍待即將發布的白皮書釐清。
items_flat.quote: We will continue to offer Zero Data Retention for frontier models. ... we're previewing Private Safety Processing, which is designed to improve safety without giving OpenAI personnel access to the underlying content.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們將繼續為前沿模型提供 Zero Data Retention。...我們正在預覽 Private Safety Processing，旨在提升安全性，同時不讓 OpenAI 人員存取底層內容。

items_flat.title_en: Grok 4.6 now generally available on Amazon Bedrock
items_flat.title_zh: Grok 4.6 正式上線 Amazon Bedrock
items_flat.summary_en: SpaceXAI announced that Grok 4.6 is now generally available on Amazon Bedrock. The model offers a 500k context window, configurable reasoning levels, and support for long-running agents plus interactive and visual work. Pricing is listed at $2 per million input tokens and $6 per million output tokens.
items_flat.summary_zh: SpaceXAI 宣布 Grok 4.6 已在 Amazon Bedrock 正式上線。該模型提供 50 萬 token 上下文視窗、可配置推理等級，並支援長時運行代理與互動／視覺工作。定價為每百萬輸入 token 2 美元、輸出 6 美元。
items_flat.analysis_en: Enterprise availability on Bedrock expands Grok’s reach beyond native platforms and Cursor. It strengthens SpaceXAI’s position in the agentic and coding market at a competitive price point relative to other frontier models.
items_flat.analysis_zh: Bedrock 企業可用性讓 Grok 觸及原生平台與 Cursor 以外的用戶。它以具競爭力的價格強化 SpaceXAI 在代理與編碼市場的地位。
items_flat.quote: Grok 4.6 is now generally available on Amazon Bedrock.
items_flat.quote_zh: Grok 4.6 現已在 Amazon Bedrock 正式上線。

items_flat.title_en: Meta launches native Mac app for Meta AI with system-wide dictation and screen context
items_flat.title_zh: Meta 推出原生 Mac 版 Meta AI，支援全系統聽寫與螢幕上下文
items_flat.summary_en: Meta released a native macOS beta app for Meta AI. It supports system-wide dictation, Quick Invoke, attaching Mac windows for context, and deeper integrations with Instagram, Facebook, Meta ads, and Google Workspace for business insights and content generation. A Windows version is planned but without a firm ETA.
items_flat.summary_zh: Meta 發布原生 macOS 測試版 Meta AI 應用。支援全系統聽寫、快速呼叫、附加 Mac 視窗以獲取上下文，以及與 Instagram、Facebook、Meta 廣告與 Google Workspace 的深度整合，用於商業洞察與內容生成。Windows 版本已在規劃中，但尚未公布具體時間。
items_flat.analysis_en: The app moves Meta AI further into productivity and small-business tooling, competing more directly with desktop experiences from OpenAI, Anthropic and Google. Privacy implications for training data remain a point of caution for users.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此應用讓 Meta AI 更深入生產力與中小企業工具領域，更直接競爭 OpenAI、Anthropic 與 Google 的桌面體驗。使用者仍需注意訓練資料的隱私影響。

items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 推出 ChatGPT 青少年版
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI launched a version of ChatGPT designed specifically for teenagers, with age-appropriate safeguards and features aimed at schoolwork, daily questions and companionship use cases.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 推出專為青少年設計的 ChatGPT 版本，具備適齡安全措施與功能，針對課業、日常問題與陪伴用途。
items_flat.analysis_en: Targeting the first generation growing up with AI signals both product expansion and regulatory/parental pressure around youth safety. Success will depend on effective age verification and content controls.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 鎖定第一代與 AI 一起成長的用戶，顯示產品擴張與針對青少年安全的監管／家長壓力。成敗將取決於有效的年齡驗證與內容控管。

items_flat.title_zh: ChatGPT 廣告擴張至歐洲多國
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced the expansion of ChatGPT Ads to 31 European countries including Germany, France, Spain, Italy and others. The move follows earlier testing of advertising inside ChatGPT.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 宣布 ChatGPT Ads 擴張至包括德國、法國、西班牙、義大利等 31 個歐洲國家。此舉延續稍早在 ChatGPT 內測試廣告的計畫。
items_flat.analysis_en: Advertising remains a key monetization lever for consumer ChatGPT usage. European rollout tests regulatory and user acceptance under stricter privacy regimes.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 廣告仍是消費端 ChatGPT 變現的重要槓桿。歐洲上線將測試在更嚴格隱私規範下的監管與用戶接受度。

brief_en: OpenAI previewed Private Safety Processing to keep Zero Data Retention while detecting multi-turn risks. SpaceXAI made Grok 4.6 available on Amazon Bedrock. Meta launched a native Mac app for Meta AI with system-wide dictation and screen context. OpenAI also expanded ChatGPT Ads in Europe and introduced ChatGPT for Teens.
brief_zh: OpenAI 預覽 Private Safety Processing，在維持 Zero Data Retention 下偵測多輪風險。SpaceXAI 讓 Grok 4.6 上線 Amazon Bedrock。Meta 推出原生 Mac 版 Meta AI，支援全系統聽寫與螢幕上下文。OpenAI 另擴張 ChatGPT 廣告至歐洲並推出青少年版。
